data.rationale: The proposal matches the true procedure (Careers, Openings, filter by country, team and time type, search, open a job and apply) in the right order with the right parameters. It adds an optional keyword and leaves the action (open or save) as a loose "job listing to open" instead of a named parameter, which is a small gap in an otherwise automatable spec.
